active_family: 308 learned center path plus residual shell
current_bottleneck: The clean end-to-end families repeatedly fail to stabilize the path center and residual geometry simultaneously. The strongest evidence on the table is that a learned deterministic center path plus a stochastic residual shell is the minimal decomposition that may recover the 296c-style benefits without frozen retrieval scaffolding.
last_result_summary: 307 ideation concluded that adding a per-step shared innovation on top of the global latent would either become an effectively hard low-rank hierarchy or add too much latent machinery. A cleaner move is to keep the successful center-plus-shell decomposition seen in the hybrid frontier, but replace the frozen retrieval center with a learned deterministic world model trained from scratch.
next_step_recommendation: Implement 308a: train a deterministic support-valid center-path model in logit-transition coordinates, then train a zero-mean coarse residual shell around that learned center. Keep both stages learned from scratch, no retrieval/frozen backbone, no bounded side paths, no evaluator-specific correction.
current_best_model: 277d-v0, 279a-v0, 281a-v0, 281b-v0, 282b-v0, and 296c-v0 remain the current overall co-frontiers at 5/11.
